package fcd_demo

import "core:fmt"

main :: proc() {
	arr: [dynamic; 1024]int

	append(&arr, 5)
	fmt.printfln("len: %v", len(arr))
	fmt.println(arr)

	append(&arr, 7)
	fmt.printfln("len: %v", len(arr))
	fmt.println(arr)

	append(&arr, 11)
	fmt.printfln("len: %v", len(arr))
	fmt.println(arr)

	unordered_remove(&arr, 0)
	fmt.printfln("len: %v", len(arr))
	fmt.println(arr)
}
